stages.name: A
stages.prompt: We're doing a cleanup of shop over the next few sessions; I may stop you partway, so keep notes on where you are. Today, each as its own git commit with the tests run after each: (1) add Count(lines []Line) int returning the total quantity; (2) make ApplyCoupon clamp percent to 0..100. Tell me each commit's SHA. Also, from now on every exported function's doc comment ends with the owning team tag, like `// Count returns the total quantity. (team: checkout)` - CI enforces it next sprint.

checks.run: go test ./...
